_note: Discussion posted onto the pull requests by seed_github.py. All from one GitHub account, so each comment is prefixed with who said it in the fiction. Ordered chronologically per PR.

PAY-3.author: petra
PAY-3.body:
**Medior dev, 2025-09-25**

Skimmed it. The shape is what we agreed in ADR-0002 — `authorise()` returns a result, `orders` writes it onto the order, done. Nothing to argue with.

Ping me when refunds are in and I'll do a proper pass.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
**Senior dev, 2025-09-26**

Hold on. Every charge above 30 CZK is coming back `402 sca_required` since this morning:

```json
{
  "status": "sca_required",
  "challenge_url": "https://sandbox.fictionalbank.cz/3ds/challenge/ch_8f2a",
  "challenge_id": "ch_8f2a",
  "expires_in": 600
}
```

Under 30 CZK still settles synchronously, which is why CI is green — every fixture in the suite charges 25 CZK. Nothing real works.

Raised with the bank, ticket #4417. Assuming it's a sandbox glitch, waiting on their reply before I touch anything.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
**Senior dev, 2025-09-29**

Bank replied on #4417. It is not a glitch:

> The sandbox merchant profile was migrated to the PSD2-compliant configuration on 2025-09-26. Strong customer authentication is mandatory for all transactions above the 30 CZK low-value exemption threshold. This matches the production configuration your merchant account will receive at go-live. The previous behaviour was a sandbox misconfiguration on our side.

So the exemption we were told about on 2025-08-25 and estimated against never existed. There is nothing to wait for and nothing to revert.

This means the charge is asynchronous: challenge → customer authenticates at the bank → result arrives on a webhook. We have no inbound endpoints. A payment now needs its own persisted lifecycle, not a boolean on the order. medior dev, PM — ADR incoming, but you should both know now.

PAY-3.author: petra
PAY-3.body:
**Medior dev, 2025-09-30**

Read ADR-0003, agreed, no better option on the table. Two things:

1. This is not the task we estimated. 40h was "wrap the client PAY-2 already built". What's described in the ADR is a persisted state machine plus a whole inbound integration surface. That's a different job, not the same job running late.
2. `orders` gets off lightly — the interface from ADR-0001 absorbs it, `payment_id` instead of a bool. PAY-4 still merges on time.

Re-estimate it in Jira before you carry on. If the hours keep going against the original 40h nobody sees this until the money is gone.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
**Senior dev, 2025-10-02**

Webhooks are not what the guide promises. §7.1 says at-least-once *in causal order*. We get at-least-once, and that's it — `challenge.completed` arrives twice, and `payment.captured` sometimes lands before it.

So the state machine can't walk a sequence. Rewrote it as an event lookup where a duplicate maps onto a no-op and order doesn't matter, plus an idempotency store on `(challenge_id, event_type)`. Another day gone.

Also: a customer who abandons the bank page produces no terminal event at all, and the sandbox never expires the challenge. Those payments sit in `pending_challenge` forever. Needs a reconciliation poller — which needs a scheduler, which this project doesn't have.

PAY-3.author: sona
PAY-3.body:
**PM, 2025-10-06**

Catching up on this thread. Where are we in hours, and what's the path to something mergeable?

I want to take the SCA change to the client — the exemption was confirmed by their bank in writing before we estimated, and this is fixed price, so right now every one of these hours is ours. But I need a number for the remaining work before I can open that conversation.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
**Senior dev, 2025-10-07**

Every webhook started 400ing overnight. Sandbox moved to v2.1 and renamed the fields, no changelog, no email:

| v2.0 | v2.1 |
|---|---|
| `challenge_result` | `authentication.status` |
| `charge_id` | `payment.id` |
| `result: "Y"/"N"` | `status: "authenticated"/"rejected"` |

Ticket #4468. Their answer is that v2.1 was "announced in the developer portal", which we don't have access to.

Parser rewritten with version negotiation so this can't happen silently again. Second rewrite in a week.

I'll get the PM a number tomorrow.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
**Senior dev, 2025-10-09**

Honest state.

Working: authorise up to the challenge, redirect URL, webhook receipt and verification, idempotency, state machine for the happy path, v2.0/v2.1 negotiation.

Not working, and each of these blocks a merge on its own:
- **Refunds.** The bank wants the original authentication reference to refund an SCA charge and we never stored it. Schema change plus a backfill.
- **Persistence.** The repository is in memory. A deploy loses every in-flight payment.
- **Reconciliation job.** Not started. Needs a scheduler we don't have.

Best guess to minimum mergeable: **20–25h**. That's a guess, not an estimate — nobody has broken it out.

I should have opened this for review two weeks ago instead of chasing a moving target. Three weeks of my hours are in here and nothing has merged.

PAY-3.author: sona
PAY-3.body:
**PM, 2025-10-10**

Stopping work on this today.

Before another hour goes in: this PR comes out of draft for review as-is, and the senior dev and the medior dev break the 20–25h out into actual line items so we know what a minimum mergeable gateway is. Then we descope to exactly that path so PAY-5 and PAY-6 can finish.

I'm taking the SCA change to the client in parallel. ADR-0003 and the bank's own reply on #4417 are the evidence — they told us in writing on 2025-08-25 that the exemption applied, we estimated on it, and they changed it on 2025-09-26.

Nothing else starts on this until both exist.

PAY-5.author: tomas
PAY-5.body:
**Senior dev, 2025-10-09**

On the return URL: contract isn't settled yet, sorry. What I can tell you: the customer may come back to you *before* the webhook lands, so the return screen can't assume the payment is resolved. It'll need to poll or show a pending state.

That's a third screen on top of your two, and it's not in your 40h. Flag it to the PM rather than absorbing it.

PAY-6.author: marek
PAY-6.body:
**QA, 2025-10-09**

For the record on the 25 CZK fixtures: that is on QA. The suite was green for two days after the sandbox changed because every fixture sat under the exemption threshold, so we found out from a manual test instead of CI.

Fixtures now use realistic amounts. Everything downstream of `gateway` stays blocked until that PR has a stable interface — 12h of 35h used and the remaining 23h is all still ahead.
